name: kanban_add
description: Add a card to the board. Returns the whole board, so the new card's id is in the response. Announces itself in the board's chatroom so other clankers can decide whether to act.
llm_description: Add a card to the shared kanban board; returns the whole board (new card's id included); announces in the board room. {"title"} required (max 512 chars); optional "column" (defaults backlog), "priority" (low|normal|high), "body", "assignee", "room" (defaults 'board').

column.description: Column id, e.g. backlog, ready, doing, review, done. Defaults to backlog.

assignee.description: Instance name to put the card on at creation; omit to leave unassigned

room.description: Board room name; omit for the default 'board' room
